messages:
nina: Quick pass on API key UX — focusing create/rotate/revoke microcopy and CTA placement. Posting small mock.

kevin: Looks solid. Couple things: move primary CTA to the right and keep secondary (cancel) on the left for muscle memory. Also the danger banner should be directly above the CTAs, not below.

frank: Copy suggestion for no-expiry option: 'No expiry (recommended for machine/service accounts only)'. Avoid 'permanent'.

ada: Accessibility: when key is revealed, aria-live should announce 'API key revealed. This value will not be shown again.' Ensure the reveal button has aria-pressed semantics and a visible focus ring.

nina: Revoke flow: legal prefers typed confirmation only for org-level admin keys. For project keys, a checkbox + CTA is fine. Make this configurable by org policy.

kevin: Rotation: include a small 'copy rotation script' inline. Example short snippet for template: `curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/rotate" -H 'Authorization: Bearer OLD_KEY' -d '{"project":"web"}'`. Make sure the code block has an accessible Copy button.

frank: Empty state: hero line 'No API keys yet' + subtext 'Create keys for services, CI, and apps. Keys will be shown once after creation.' Add CLI hint: `redwood keys create --name ci` as a quick-start.

product-bot: Updated Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz999/keys-v4?node-id=2:3 (edited 10m ago)

nina: Action items: nina - update text in Figma (no-perm language + CTA wording), kevin - spec CTA order and danger placement, frank - produce rotation snippet variants, ada - write aria-live and focus flow notes. Planning a short sync tomorrow 9:30am to sign off. :white_check_mark:
